webdav.zu-viele-anfragen-bitte: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
webdav.bitte-mit-e-mail: Please sign in with email address and API key.
webdav.e-mail-adresse-oder: Email address or API key is wrong. The drive needs an API key (My account → API keys), not your password.
webdav.ordner-lassen-sich-ueber: Folders can’t be created via the drive. You create folders in Ablago’s library.
webdav.loeschen-geht-ueber-das: Deleting doesn’t work via the drive (yet). Please delete in Ablago itself.
webdav.umbenennen-und-verschieben-gehen: Renaming and moving don’t work via the drive (yet). Please do it in Ablago itself.
webdav.kopieren-innerhalb-des-laufwerks: Copying within the drive doesn’t work (yet). Download the file and file it again.
webdav.diese-methode-unterstuetzt-das: The drive doesn’t support this method.
webdav.dies-ist-ein-ordner: This is a folder of the Ablago drive. Connect the address in Explorer, Finder or the Files app – see the user manual “Connect as a drive”.
webdav.diese-datei-ist-noch: This file hasn’t finished being filed yet.
webdav.hier-laesst-sich-nichts-2: Nothing can be filed here. Put files into “New post” or into a folder’s tab folder.
webdav.dieser-api-schluessel-darf: This API key may only read. For filing it needs “read and write”.
webdav.die-datei-ist-zu-2: The file is too large (at most 100 MB).
webdav.es-laufen-schon-mehrere: Several uploads are already running. Please wait a moment.
webdav.im-register-gibt-es: “{name2}” already exists on the tab “{name}”, and it has no versioning. Give the file a different name.
